title: Jesus Heals Peter's Family
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: Jesus and His friends came to Capernaum, a town by the lake. On the Sabbath, the day of rest, Jesus taught in the meeting house.
The people were amazed. Jesus did not just repeat what others said. He taught like someone who truly knew Heavenly Father.
Then Jesus went to Simon Peter’s house. Peter’s wife’s mother was in bed, very sick with a fever. They told Jesus about her.
p2: Jesus went to her, took her hand, and lifted her up. Right away the fever left her! She got up and helped serve them all.
That evening, people brought sick friends to the door. Jesus healed many, because He cares when people hurt. Tonight, pray for someone who feels sick or sad.
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
